description: The shell hosts the Panel webview and exposes no IPC commands to it; only core window permissions are granted. `start-dragging` is required so the Panel's `data-tauri-drag-region` strip (macOS overlay-titlebar workaround) can actually move the window. The `remote` block extends this capability to the Panel's loopback origin (the daemon serves it from http://127.0.0.1:18790), otherwise Tauri does NOT inject `__TAURI_INTERNALS__` on remote origins and the drag-region runtime fails silently.
